Quick answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Have another question? Call or WhatsApp us for help with your RO requirement.

Do you provide RO repair at home in Gurugram?

You can enquire about doorstep RO repair in Gurugram by calling 6397092302 or sending your area and issue on WhatsApp. Availability and appointment timing will be confirmed directly.

Which RO brands do you service?

Enquiries are welcome for KENT, Aquaguard, Livpure, Pureit, AO Smith, Blue Star, Havells, LG and other major brands. Please share the brand and model so service compatibility can be confirmed.

Do you replace RO filters and membranes?

Contact us for filter and membrane replacement. The exact part, compatibility and price depend on your purifier model and service requirement.

What is the cost of RO servicing?

RO service starts at ₹200. Final charges may vary by purifier model, issue, parts required and location. Call or WhatsApp with the brand, problem and area to confirm the applicable price before service.

Do you provide RO AMC?

You can enquire about an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC). Coverage, visit frequency, included parts and pricing should be confirmed before purchase.

Can I book an RO technician through WhatsApp?

Yes. Use any WhatsApp enquiry button on this page to send your requirement. Include your name, area, brand and the problem for a faster response.

Do you sell new RO water purifiers?

Yes, you can enquire about domestic and commercial RO systems, as well as new installation. Message us for available options and pricing.

Which areas of Gurugram do you cover?

We focus on Gurugram, including DLF phases, multiple sectors, Golf Course Road, Golf Course Extension Road, Sohna Road, Palam Vihar, Sushant Lok, South City and New Gurgaon. Confirm availability for your exact address before booking.
